preconditions.description: The number of castles n must be between 1 and 40.
The amount of liquid k must be between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= a[i][j] <= 1 for i in range(n) for j in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each element in the adjacency matrix must be either 0 or 1.
No castle can be connected to itself.

preconditions.expression: all(a[i][j] == a[j][i] for i in range(n) for j in range(n))
preconditions.description: The adjacency matrix must be symmetric.

postconditions.description: The output must be within an absolute or relative error of 1e-6 compared to the expected output.
The output must be a non-negative number representing the maximum sum of stabilities.
